name: recourse_call
title: Call any Recourse tool by name
description:
Call any Recourse tool by name. Use this for everything not already offered as its own tool; behaviour is identical to calling that tool directly, including argument validation. Pass the tool's arguments under `args`.

Available tools:
- recourse.status: Live system status, model, tool counts, readiness.
- recourse.registry: List registered tools/genes and their current promoted state.
- recourse.upgrade_report: How the upgraded system differs from the boot baseline.
- recourse.nightly_report: The latest self-attested nightly upgrade report (dream -> forge -> benchmark delta). Empty until the first nightly cycle runs.
- recourse.self_mod_status: Harness self-modification status: last nightly run, pending approvals, applied/reverted patches, and the protected-path policy.
- recourse.capabilities: Which self-hosted tools Recourse adopted to back its own internal operations (dogfood).
- recourse.selfhosted: List live self-hosted tools/artifacts and their kinds (function/cli/api/mcp/a2a/loop).
- recourse.exportable: List verified registry tools that carry real source + suite and can therefore be exported as SKILL.md folders.
- recourse.export_skill: Write a verified registry tool into the configured export root as an open SKILL.md folder (source + test suite embedded). Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.import_skill: Import a skill from a configured skill library (rootId + rel) through the promotion gate. If it embeds code + suite in a code domain it is verified for real; prose-only skills are recorded as pending and never fabricated into the registry. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.inspect_gene: Read the full record for a named registry tool: domain, health, current version, score, pass state, verifier notes.
- recourse.evolve: Ask the mutator to propose a new capability for a domain. Promotions only land if the produced code passes the real sandbox + lint gate. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.promote: Promote a pending gene by its id through the approval gate. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.compose: Generate an original "in the vein of" track (steely-dan | jasper-ballad | dangelo-glasper | airplane). Loop mode (default): a deterministic 4/8/16-bar loop -> .mid + a SoundLab .seq pocket. Mode "arr": a non-looping written-out arc (intro/A/bridge/final/outro, jasper final key-lift) -> .mid only. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.rate_track: Record your 1-5 rating for a reproducible composition so the composer learns to steer toward what you like. Same style+seed+rating updates the episode. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.learned: Read per-style learned quality biases, episodes, and leaderboard so you can see how ratings are shaping composition.
- recourse.benchmark: Grade the composer on computed metrics (integrity, harmony, loop closure, style root-motion adherence, voice-leading, richness, nuance) across all styles. Does NOT grade taste/timbre — that needs your ears + recourse.rate_track.
- recourse.benchmark_leaderboard: The hash-chained record of every external benchmark run, ranked by solved count, with per-run deltas and registry attestations. Read-only.
- recourse.benchmark_ledger: Recent self-attested benchmark records and whether the hash chain is intact. Read-only.
- recourse.wallet: Per-token spend budgets, remaining balances, and whether the hash-chained ledger is intact. Read-only.
- recourse.telemetry: Machine load/memory and git state, plus the work-window decision used to schedule heavy jobs. Read-only.
- recourse.audio_status: Whether the audio/video transcription sidecar is reachable and its ASR backend is available. Read-only.
- recourse.compose_soundlab: Compose a style-driven piece and emit the SoundLab bridge contract. Feed the returned JSON to a running SoundLab via window.__recourse.load(piece), then __recourse.play(). Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.axiom_status: Probe Axiom harness reachability and capability grid from Recourse.
- recourse.kg_live_status: Probe Open Targets Platform and PubTator 3.0 availability for the live oncology evidence layer.
- recourse.kg_live_graph: Query Open Targets + PubTator 3.0 and merge with the canonical curated KG into a grounded, provenance-tagged graph. Providers that are down are reported ok:false and simply contribute nothing.
- recourse.ode_synthesize: Build the live graph and map Open Targets + PubTator evidence into a concrete OdeSimulationParams bundle (Overlay Oncology solveOdeTumorImmuneSystem contract) with per-parameter provenance. Parameters are labeled evidence-derived / literature-prior / canonical / calibrated.
- recourse.dosing_optimize: Synthesize evidence-to-ODE params then sweep therapy modes × dose levels, computing per-arm cure-reachability and a seeded subclone-extinction probability. Arms are real deterministic ODE runs; extinctionProbability is an ensemble fraction, not a fitted clinical statistic.
- recourse.pipeline_dossier: One call: live graph → ODE params → dosing optimization → SBML Level 3 + PhysiCell XML exports, then hash-chain every stage into a verifiable evidence dossier. Reads the real providers; a down provider contributes nothing.
- recourse.axiom_build: Delegate tool synthesis to Axiom Agent harness, verify with Recourse executionSandbox, and materialize into .selfhosted/ manifest. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.sandbox_status: Whether the WASM capability sandbox runtime (QuickJS) is live, the warm guest-context count, and the effective default execution path.
- recourse.memory_tiered: Durable episodic + semantic memory backend (SQLite/memory), DB path, episode count, fact count.
- recourse.recall_memory: Semantic recall over Recourse vector memory for a query. Read-only.
- recourse.inspect_learner: Learner status: episodes, gene beliefs, directives, and last report.
- recourse.problems: The curated hard-math problem bank with acceptance tests and tier.
- recourse.run_forge: Run the honest self-improvement forge loop (agenda -> model implementation -> sandbox verify -> promote). Promotions only land on a real green suite. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.execute_selfhosted: Call a self-hosted tool method. Execution goes through the WASM capability sandbox by default (default-deny grants); the response reports which mode actually ran. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.consolidate_memory: Fold episode clusters into durable semantic facts (idempotent). Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.promote_skills: Run the skill auto-promotion pass: generalist genes -> backing tool re-verified in the sandbox -> lint gate -> SKILL.md export. Rejected/skipped outcomes are reported honestly. Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.revert: Revert an applied patch by its revert token (as recorded in provenance). Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.skills: The signed, versioned skill registry (id, version, license, author, signature presence). Read-only.
- recourse.publish_skill: Publish a versioned skill to the registry (signed with the local skill secret when configured). Mutating: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.connectors: Registered external connectors and their live health probes. Read-only.
- recourse.validate_plugin: Validate a plugin manifest (schema + default-deny capabilities) and report its signature status. Read-only.
- recourse.dsh_plugins: DeepSeek Harness cordis bundles generated by Recourse, with each manifest's signature state, plus the profiles the harness has. Read-only.
- recourse.dsh_scaffold: Generate a DeepSeek Harness cordis bundle from a declarative spec (id, packageName, description, tools[]). dryRun renders the file list and signed manifest without touching disk. Mutating unless dryRun: requires RECOURSE_API_SECRET.
- recourse.grounding_status: Grounding config, the trust registry (which providers may be quoted and why), and live reachability of both research services. Read-only.
- recourse.grounding_ledger: The hash-chained record of what grounded a build: query, source ids with trust levels, and chain integrity. Answers "what was this tool actually built from?". Read-only.
- recourse.dsh_scaffold_render: Generate a DeepSeek Harness cordis bundle from a declarative spec and return the file list plus the signed manifest WITHOUT writing to disk. Read-only.
- recourse.research_ground: Gather real external literature for a tool idea before writing it, and return exactly what would be injected into the forge prompt. Only "retrieved" sources are quotable; others are returned as leads with their trust level and reason. Reports honestly when a research service is down.
- recourse.traces: Recently finished spans with W3C trace context (name, ids, status, duration). Read-only.
- recourse.tracing_status: Whether an OTLP exporter is configured, the service name, and the buffered span count. Read-only.
- recourse.slopbench_status: Probe SlopCodeBench availability: CLI on PATH, Docker daemon, uv, and configured agent/model. Read-only.
- recourse.slopbench_run: Run a SlopCodeBench iterative specification refinement benchmark. Measures code erosion, verbosity, and structural degradation across checkpoints. Requires Docker and an API key.
- recourse.slopbench_eval: Evaluate a completed SlopCodeBench run directory: per-checkpoint pass rates, verbosity, structural erosion, and quality metrics. Read-only.
- recourse.slopbench_metrics: Compute quality metrics (verbosity, erosion, LOC, cyclomatic complexity, maintainability) for a run directory or code snapshot. Read-only.
- recourse.slopbench_list_runs: List completed SlopCodeBench run directories with their problem sets, agents, and timestamps. Read-only.
- recourse.coding_pipelines: Discover all registered coding pipelines (opencode, deepseek, axiom, settlement, slopcodebench) with live availability and standings. Read-only.
- recourse.coding_pipelines_ledger: Hash-chained history of pipeline benchmark runs with per-pipeline standings. Read-only.
